observations:
Torah LM2 #80 is a short, tightly structured teaching built around a single Mishnah (Yoma Chapter 2). The five packages derived from the bechina edges — (1) Torah depth/ramp, (2) intellect/Temple, (3) pais/entreating, (4) Yetzer Hara/appointed officer, (5) hypocrisy/finger-display — cover all the thematic terrain of the Torah.

The missing concepts identified in the gap analysis (deshen, hitnasiut, kfira, audacity, broken leg, kingship-without-a-crown) can all be absorbed into the existing packages:
- deshen and hitnasiut → Package 1 (the fruit of Torah depth attainment)
- audacity, kfira, broken leg, malkuta bela taga → Package 4 (the evil domain of the Yetzer Hara)

There is no cluster of 3+ concepts that forms an independent thematic domain outside these existing packages. The Torah's argument is a single arc:
[Torah depth (Pkg 1)] qualifies a leader → [Intellect/Temple (Pkg 2)] refuses hypocrisy → [Yetzer Hara (Pkg 4)] tempts via [hypocrisy-display (Pkg 5)] → corrective: [community entreating (Pkg 3)] is the only proper selection mechanism.

The good/evil mirror in this Torah:
- Package 1 (Torah depth/כבש) mirrors Package 4 (Yetzer Hara/ממונה) — the good force that qualifies leaders vs. the evil force that corrupts the selection process
- Package 2 (Intellect/Temple) mirrors Package 5 (hypocrisy/finger-display) — the authentic cognitive holiness that refuses pretense vs. the performance of false piety
- Package 3 (pais/entreating) is the good resolution with no direct evil mirror — it is the procedural correction to the entire evil dynamic.
